project_name: Bust-up close-up anime portrait of this exact character, Harrison Croft, 30-year-old gritty Yorkshire endurance driver known as The Yorkshire Hammer. Exact matching short rugged brown buzz-crop hair, weathered stubble jaw, small scar on left cheekbone, resolute unyielding determined gaze, exact same heavy-duty Oxford navy racing collar with quilted shoulder trim, pit radio mic clipped to collar. Thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, dynamic speed lines, cel-shaded anime style, isolated solid background
